name: tune-strip
description: Windows only. Shows the song playing in Spotify above the prompt, with cover and playback controls. No login, and nothing leaves your computer.

size.title: Size
size.description: auto: its own bar in the desktop app, compact in the row when it fits. full, compact, mini: fixed. off: hidden. Also /tune size and /tune on|off.

extraButtons.title: More buttons
extraButtons.description: Adds −15 s, +15 s, shuffle and repeat to the desktop bar. The commands /tune back, forward, shuffle and repeat work either way.

beat.title: Beat for Clawd
beat.description: Finds the beat of the song on this PC so Clawd can move to it. Listens to Spotify only and records nothing. Also /tune beat on|off.

beatOffset.title: Beat delay (ms)
beatOffset.description: Shifts the beat, e.g. for Bluetooth headphones. Positive: later. Also /tune beat offset.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (s)
pollSeconds.description: How often the bar reads the Windows media controls while it is on screen.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the texts. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /tune language.
